## Basic Text Search UI & UX Using Shopify Standard Search

---

### <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-0">:person_with_crown:</custom> User Story

**As a** shopper on a Shopify store, **I want** to easily find products using a search bar that is visually clear, responsive, and provides relevant results, **so that** I can quickly locate items without browsing through multiple pages.

---

| **Requirement** | **Description** |  | **Links** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| Submit Action | Hitting

should submit the search querry |   |  |

## Search Results Page

## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-8">:person_with_crown:</custom> User Story

**As a** shopper on a Shopify store, **I want** to see a well-organized and visually clear list of relevant products after I search for a term, **so that** I can quickly find the item I'm looking for and make a purchase decision.

---

Implement a user-friendly **search results page** that displays relevant product results. The page should be styled consistently with the store theme and include features that enhance product discoverability and conversion.

| **Requirement** | **Description** | **Link / Example** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Display Results | Show matching products based on the search query on a search results page | [standard page layout](https://www.figma.com/design/iOpGWO38HkhnTYkEeEq8Oz/Laioutr-Basic?node-id=17-69657) \| [ambiendo](https://www.figma.com/design/gDN7wlDFp5mwXQfRDhotzR/Ambiendo---sunny?node-id=72-160914) |
| Query Highlight | Display the user's search term clearly on the results page. | [mobile](https://www.figma.com/design/L5EsT6m0VoOXsqqDHXtCe3/laioutr-SHOP?node-id=1359-228442&t=3GgRqyYPI4KvyUBH-4) \| [desktop](https://www.figma.com/design/L5EsT6m0VoOXsqqDHXtCe3/laioutr-SHOP?node-id=1359-228603&t=3GgRqyYPI4KvyUBH-4) ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=5731e061-79e1-4f49-8960-60e6ae0819a5&&collection=&height=33&occurrenceKey=null&width=356&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null) |
| Result Count | Show the number of results found | ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=009d0416-1deb-43dc-8417-204418cd1380&&collection=&height=78&occurrenceKey=null&width=427&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null) [amount pill](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=18636-187911) |
| Filterbar | Use basic filterbar for sorting and filtering option | ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=26aad523-7761-4e7a-9c2f-469085a9c2ed&&collection=&height=82&occurrenceKey=null&width=456&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null) filterbar: [mobile](https://www.figma.com/design/L5EsT6m0VoOXsqqDHXtCe3/laioutr-SHOP?node-id=82-217205&t=3GgRqyYPI4KvyUBH-4) \| [desktop](https://www.figma.com/design/L5EsT6m0VoOXsqqDHXtCe3/laioutr-SHOP?node-id=82-220118&t=3GgRqyYPI4KvyUBH-4) |
| Product Grid | Use product grid for displaying results | [mobile](https://www.figma.com/design/L5EsT6m0VoOXsqqDHXtCe3/laioutr-SHOP?node-id=73-75128&t=3GgRqyYPI4KvyUBH-4) \| [desktop](https://www.figma.com/design/L5EsT6m0VoOXsqqDHXtCe3/laioutr-SHOP?node-id=73-75194&t=3GgRqyYPI4KvyUBH-4)  |

button is clicked: hide empty state message show filterbar load product list with all products | [standard layout](https://www.figma.com/design/iOpGWO38HkhnTYkEeEq8Oz/Laioutr-Basic?node-id=38-30131&t=xppr2dTiGfn0a5IL-4) \| [ambiendo example](https://www.figma.com/design/gDN7wlDFp5mwXQfRDhotzR/Ambiendo---sunny?node-id=79-36446&t=DlhHohoI87DkZZhT-4) [no results message mobile](https://www.figma.com/design/L5EsT6m0VoOXsqqDHXtCe3/laioutr-SHOP?node-id=1429-227393&t=3GgRqyYPI4KvyUBH-4) \| [desktop](https://www.figma.com/design/L5EsT6m0VoOXsqqDHXtCe3/laioutr-SHOP?node-id=1429-227737&t=3GgRqyYPI4KvyUBH-4)  all products [laioutr](https://www.figma.com/design/iOpGWO38HkhnTYkEeEq8Oz/Laioutr-Basic?node-id=38-30132&t=xppr2dTiGfn0a5IL-4) \| [ambiendo](https://www.figma.com/design/gDN7wlDFp5mwXQfRDhotzR/Ambiendo---sunny?node-id=79-60624&t=DlhHohoI87DkZZhT-4) |
| SEO-Friendly URLs | Ensure URLs reflect the search term and filters |  |
| Search Term Persistence <custom data-type="status" data-id="id-9">nice to have</custom>  | Keep the query visible in the search field after submission. |  |
| Performance | Results should load within 2 seconds under normal conditions. |  |
| Accessability | Must comply with **WCAG 2.1 AA**: keyboard navigation, screen reader support, proper color contrast, and semantic HTML. User can navigate the entire page using only a keyboard. All images and links have descriptive labels or `alt` text. Search results are announced to screen readers after submission. Filter controls are labeled and usable by assistive tech. Page meets automated accessibility checks (e.g., Lighthouse, WAVE). Manual testing confirms screen reader usability (e.g., with NVDA, VoiceOver). |  |

enrichedData.purpose: Enables shoppers to quickly locate products through a prominent, responsive search bar with instant suggestions, and view well-organized search results with filtering and sorting capabilities.
useCases: Display prominent search bar in header available on all pages
Autofocus search input on click or tap for immediate typing
Expand search to full-width on mobile devices
Provide clear button inside search field to reset query
Display search suggestions in overlay dropdown
Show friendly empty state message when no suggestions available
Submit search query on Enter key press
Navigate to search results page with highlighted query term
Display result count with amount pill indicator
Show product grid with filter bar and sorting options
Implement infinite scroll with load more component
Display friendly no results message with product recommendations
Allow clearing search to show all products
Generate SEO-friendly URLs reflecting search terms and filters
Ensure WCAG 2.1 AA compliance with keyboard navigation and screen reader support
